gizmo.title: Umculo obhaliweyo
gizmo.description: Ibonisa ize idlale umculo obhaliweyo, iithebhu zegitare kunye nemiqondiso yomculo nge-alphaTex okanye i-MusicXML.

configure.title: Imiqondiso ye-AlphaTex
configure.description: Uphawu lwe-alphaTex olungaphakathi lomculo obhaliweyo. Luhlele ngqo ukuze ubhale imiqondiso; lugcinwa kwitemplate ukuze izithuba zigcinwe.

configure.title: Ifayile yomculo
configure.description: Faka okanye uqhagamshele kwifayile ye-MusicXML (.xml/.musicxml/.mxl) okanye ye-Guitar Pro (.gp3/.gp4/.gp5/.gpx/.gp). Ithatha indawo ye-alphaTex engaphakathi xa isetiwe.

advanced.title: Ukudlalwa kwesandi
advanced.description: Kuvuliwe ngokungagqibekanga - mamela umculo obhaliweyo udlalwa ngesidibanisi-sandi esakhelwe ngaphakathi. Cima ukuze ube kwimowudi yokujonga kuphela (akukho sandi).

advanced.title: Bonisa iinketho zomboniso
advanced.description: Bonisa amaqhosha okusondeza, okolula nolwakhiwo kwibha yesidlali.

advanced.title: Bonisa amaqhosha okuthumela ngaphandle
advanced.description: Bonisa amaqhosha okukhuphela i-MIDI nokuprinta/i-PDF kwibha yesidlali.
